Is an expired medicine sitting on your pharmacy shelf right now?

A survey of 100 pharmacists in Delhi, published in the Indian Journal of Pharmacology in 2016, found only 53% agreed there was a system to remove expired medicines from stock. Without one, expiry is checked by eye and found too late.

A simple weekly expiry check for a hospital pharmacy:
• List every batch expiring in the next 90 days.
• Flag expired stock that is still on the shelf and remove it the same day.
• Issue the batch that expires first, first.
• Record the batch number and expiry date the moment new stock arrives.
• Check items at or below reorder level, so you buy only what you will use.
